muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /stream datastar(sse(Stream(ctx, send, marshalJSON(sendSignals))))" -}}
{{- with .Mode "inner" -}}{{- end -}}
<li>{{ .Result }}</li>
{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Sig struct {
	OK bool `json:"ok"`
}

// Server overrides the template's default patch target per event: the
// template sets mode inner; the method overrides one send with append and a
// selector derived from a record ID, and marks a signals patch onlyIfMissing.
type Server struct{}

func (Server) Stream(_ context.Context,
	send func(item string, opts ...DatastarPatchElementOption) error,
	sendSignals func(s Sig, opts ...DatastarPatchSignalsOption) error,
) {
	_ = send("a")
	_ = send("b", WithMode("append"), WithSelectorID("row-42"))
	_ = sendSignals(Sig{OK: true}, WithOnlyIfMissing(true))
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/stream", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	body := rec.Body.String()
	if want := "data: mode inner\ndata: elements <li>a</li>\n\n"; !strings.Contains(body, want) {
		t.Errorf("body = %q, want the template-default event %q", body, want)
	}
	if want := "data: selector #row-42\ndata: mode append\ndata: elements <li>b</li>\n\n"; !strings.Contains(body, want) {
		t.Errorf("body = %q, want the overridden event %q", body, want)
	}
	if want := "event: datastar-patch-signals\ndata: onlyIfMissing true\ndata: signals {\"ok\":true}\n\n"; !strings.Contains(body, want) {
		t.Errorf("body = %q, want the onlyIfMissing signals frame %q", body, want)
	}
}
